nodes.description: Pure arithmetic helper safeAdd(uint a, uint b) returning a + b with overflow require.
Pure arithmetic helper safeSub(uint a, uint b) requiring b <= a and returning a - b.
Pure arithmetic helper safeMul(uint a, uint b) returning a * b with overflow require.
Pure arithmetic helper safeDiv(uint a, uint b) requiring b > 0 and returning a / b.
Public address state variable holding the current owner of the Owned/EURO contract.
Public address state variable holding the pending owner during two-step ownership transfer.
Constructor assigning owner = msg.sender at deployment.
onlyOwner function that sets newOwner to the proposed address.
Function that lets newOwner accept the ownership, emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Public token symbol string set to "EURO" in the EURO constructor.
Public token name string set to "open euro" in the EURO constructor.
Public uint8 decimals set to 2 in the EURO constructor.
Public uint holding the total token supply minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Mapping address => uint tracking token balances of every account.
Nested mapping address => address => uint tracking ERC20 allowances.
EURO constructor initialising symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and the deployer balance.
View returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
View returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to `to` using safeSub/safeAdd on the balances mapping.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Transfers tokens from `from` to `to`, decrementing allowance of msg.sender.
View returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves a spender and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that always reverts, refusing ETH.
onlyOwner function that forwards an arbitrary ERC20 transfer to the owner address.
Untrusted caller address used for ownership assignment, balance indexing and allowance checks.
Unsigned addition `c = a + b` guarded by require(c >= a); overflow class arithmetic.
Unsigned subtraction `c = a - b` guarded by require(b <= a); underflow class arithmetic.
Unsigned multiplication `c = a * b` guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b); overflow class arithmetic.
Unsigned division `c = a / b` guarded by require(b > 0); division-by-zero class arithmetic.
modifier onlyOwner require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate on privileged functions.
require(msg.sender == newOwner) access-control gate inside acceptOwnership.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed with user-supplied spender; reentrancy surface.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary token contract.

Owned constructor assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
msg.sender is compared with owner in the onlyOwner require.
The owner state variable is the right-hand side of the onlyOwner check.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
msg.sender must equal newOwner to pass the acceptOwnership require.
newOwner state variable is compared with msg.sender in acceptOwnership.
The require check guards the ownership handover body of acceptOwnership.
acceptOwnership moves owner to newOwner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and resets it to address(0).
The _newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the proposed address in newOwner.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on the source balance and on the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping as the debit account.
The `to` parameter indexes the balances mapping as the credit account.
The tokens parameter is the amount debited/credited in transfer.
transfer reads and writes the balances state mapping.
transfer mutates balances entries for sender and recipient.
approve sets allowed[msg.sender][spender].
The spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in approve.
The tokens parameter becomes the approved allowance value.
approve writes the allowed state mapping.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
The from parameter indexes balances and allowed mappings.
The to parameter indexes the balances mapping as credit account.
The tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping for the spender.
balanceOf indexes balances with the tokenOwner parameter.
balanceOf reads the balances state mapping.
allowance indexes the allowed mapping with tokenOwner.
allowance indexes the allowed mapping with spender.
allowance reads the allowed state mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] when computing the circulating supply.
EURO constructor writes the symbol state variable.
EURO constructor writes the name state variable.
EURO constructor writes the decimals state variable.
EURO constructor mints _totalSupply to the deployer address.
EURO constructor credits balances of the hardcoded deployer address.
The spender parameter becomes the callee of the external receiveApproval call.
The tokens parameter is both the approved amount and the value passed to receiveApproval.
The data parameter is attacker-controlled calldata forwarded to the callee.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall mutates the allowed allowance mapping.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the untrusted spender contract.
msg.sender is forwarded as the `from` argument to receiveApproval, giving the callee a hook back into the token.
The external receiveApproval invocation can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions before state settles.
onlyOwner transferAnyERC20Token invokes an external call on an arbitrary token contract.
The owner state variable is passed as the recipient of the swept ERC20 tokens.
The tokenAddress parameter determines which external contract is called.
The tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
